query: CDC FluView influenza surveillance weekly report week 40 2024 United States
query_rationale: CDC FluView is the primary U.S. influenza surveillance system. The time window 2024-09-29 to 2024-10-05 corresponds to MMWR Week 40 of 2024. Targeting the CDC FluView weekly report for week 40 directly is the most precise way to retrieve confirmed case counts, hospitalizations, deaths, and subnational breakdowns for this exact period.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC FluView weekly report page or PDF for MMWR week 40, 2024-2025 season
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, FluView branding, MMWR week 40 label, season 2024-2025

query: CDC influenza activity 2024-2025 season start October 2024 cases hospitalizations deaths United States
query_rationale: Targets CDC seasonal influenza activity summaries and situation updates for the 2024-2025 season onset, which would cover the late-September to early-October 2024 window. expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, 2024-2025 season label, official surveillance language

query: WHO PAHO influenza update United States October 2024 surveillance cases deaths weekly epidemiological
query_rationale: WHO and PAHO publish weekly or biweekly global and regional influenza surveillance updates that include U.S. data. These serve as independent validation of CDC figures and may provide additional breakdowns. Targeting October 2024 aligns with the task time window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: WHO global influenza update, PAHO regional influenza bulletin, or FluNet data for week 40 2024
expected_trust_signal: who.int or paho.org domain, weekly epidemiological record, FluNet reference

query: CDC influenza 2024-2025 season activity summary October 2024 FluSurv-NET hospitalization pediatric mortality week 40
query_rationale: FluSurv-NET is the CDC's influenza hospitalization surveillance network, reporting separately from FluView's ILI/positivity data. Targeting FluSurv-NET for Week 40 2024 will surface hospitalization rates and counts not captured in the main FluView weekly summary. Pediatric mortality surveillance is also a distinct CDC component. This fills the hospitalization and deaths fields that the FluView positivity-focused snippet did not provide.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC FluSurv-NET hospitalization surveillance report or CDC influenza-associated pediatric mortality report for week 40 2024
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, FluSurv-NET label, 2024-2025 season, week 40 reference
